book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: A JE'RA' U JACH TSOYIR U T'ɅN C'UJ TU TS'IBTA MATEO

content: U ts'urirob u winiquirob judío cu tucricob bic tabar u bin u chuquicob Jesús
Caj ts'oc ya'aric Jesús a ba' caj u camsaj sam ti' u camsʌwinicob. Caj u rʌc araj ti' u camsʌwinicob:

―Techex a werex ―quij Jesús―. Ca'bej cu c'uchur tu q'uinin u qui'qui' janʌnob u winiquirob judío. Ra' u q'uinin quir u c'ʌ'oticob caj u potmastajob yʌjmasir u t'ʌn C'uj uch. Soc mʌ' u quimin u parar a yʌn rocha'b ten u nʌ' uch. Ra' u q'uinin ca'bej, quir u c'ubiquenob, a teno' taren in yamtic mac tu cotor, ca' quinsaquen ten u jach ts'urirob u winiquirob judío.

U jach ts'urirob sacerdote caj u rʌc much'quintob u bʌj yejer yʌjcamsayʌjirob u t'ʌn Moisés yejer u jach ts'urirob u cajar u winiquirob judío a cu ya'aric a Nuxibo'. Ti' cu much'quinticob u bʌj ich yatoch Caifás. Ra' u jach ts'urir ti' tu cotor sacerdote, tu re'a'an yatoch tu pach u pa'te'.
Robob u c'at u tucricob bic tabar cu bin u muc u chuquicob Jesús soc u quinsa'r.
Caj ya'arajob: ―Ca' ic yʌn pajej u ts'ocar u q'uinin u qui'qui' janʌnob. Quire' je' u ts'ictarob a pimo' wa quic chuquic Jesús tan u qui'qui' janʌnob.
A xquic cu bin jayic tu jo'r Jesús a qui' u boque'
Jesús ti' yʌn ich u cajar Betania. Ti' yʌn ich yatoch Simón a ju cʌnmʌn iq'uer u ca' uch.

Ti' yʌn Jesús, cu janʌn ich u poche'ir och. Caj u juts u bʌj xquic. U ch'amʌn tu t'aja'an a qui' u boque'. U c'aba' u chujir, alabastro, tunich u chujir tu t'aja'an ya'arir a qui' u boco'. Jach manan coj a qui' u boco'. Caj joy tu jo'r Jesús tu cura'an janʌn.
U camsʌwinicob Jesús caj yirob caj u jayaj tu jo'r Jesús a qui' u boco' caj p'ujob. Caj ya'arajob: ―Tu chen rʌc xup u taq'uin. Ba'wir ti' caj u chen mʌnaj? Mʌ' ja wirej, jach co'oj a qui' u boco'.
Wa caj cʌnaj ca'che', caj u ca' jaraj ya'ab u taq'uin quir u jasʌr ti' a jach otsir.
Jesús caj yuba ba' ya'arajob u camsʌwinicob. Caj ya'araj ti' u camsʌwinicob: ―Ba'wir ca ts'iquintiquex xquic. Tsoy caj u jayaj tin jo'r a qui' u boque'.
A otsire' rajra' ti' yʌn tu yʌnechex. Wa ber a c'at a yamtej a otsiro', ca' a yʌn yamtex. A teno' mʌ' rajra' ti' yʌnen tu yʌnechex.
A xquico', rajen caj u jayaj tin jo'r a qui' u boque'. Quire' tabar u muquic in baquer mac.
Jach taj quin wa'aric techex ―quij Jesús―. Cax wa tu cu bin u tsec'tic u jach tsoyir u t'ʌn C'uj. Je' ya'aric bic caj u jayaj tin jo'r xquic a qui' u boque' soc u c'ʌ'otic a je' xquica'.
Judas cu bin c'ubic Jesús
Caj ts'oc yiric u joyaj tu jo'r Jesús a qui' u boque'. Caj bin Judas Iscariote quir u tsicbar yejer u jach ts'urirob sacerdote. Judas raji' u camsʌwinic Jesús. Turiri' ich u doce camsʌwinicob Jesús.
Judas caj c'uchij caj u c'ataj ti' u jach ts'urir sacerdote: ―Mun ca bin a bo'oten wa quin c'ubic Jesús? Caj bo'ota'b yejer sʌc taq'uin treinta.
Ra' u q'uinino', caj u toc cʌxtaj bic tabar cu bin u c'ubic Jesús tu junan.
Jesús caj janij oq'uin yejer u camsʌwinicob

Yʌn turi' u q'uinin quir u c'uchur tu q'uinin u qui'qui' janʌnob saman. Ra' u q'uinin ca' bin u jantejob pan, raji' mʌna' u ts'ac quir u sip. C'uch u camsʌwinicob ich Jesús caj u c'atajob ti': ―Arej tenob tub a c'at a jantej a wo'och oq'uin tu q'uinin u qui'qui' janʌnob u winiquirob judío?

Caj u nuncaj Jesús caj ya'araj ti'ob: ―Xenex ich u cajar Jerusalén. Je' a wiriquex turi' xib ich yatoch. Arex ti': “A wʌjcamsʌyʌjir u c'at u tar tu janʌn oq'uin soc u c'ʌ'otic u q'uinin caj u potmastaj yʌjmasir u t'ʌn C'uj uch. Tabar u quinsa'r a wʌjcamsʌyʌjir rajen cu tar.”

U camsʌwinicob caj binob ich u cajar Jerusalén. Caj ara'b ti' xib an ten bic toc ara'b ten Jesús. Caj toc bota'b yo'och Jesús ten u camsʌwinicob quir u c'ʌ'otic u q'uinin caj potmasta'b yʌjmasir u t'ʌn C'uj uch.
Caj ac'birchʌjij, caj c'uchij Jesús quir u janʌn. Yet tarac doce u camsʌwinicob. Caj curob tu janʌnob yejer Jesús ich pojche'ir yo'och.
Tan tu janʌn Jesús caj ya'araj: ―Jach taj quin wa'aric techex. Yʌn turiri' techex ca bin a mucu c'ubiquen.
Caj jach choquij yorob u camsʌwinicob Jesús. Jujuntur u camsʌwinicob cu bin u c'aticob ti' Jesús: ―Ten wa quin bin in c'ubiquech Jaj Ts'urir?
Caj u nuncaj Jesús caj ya'araj ti'ob: ―A je' cu ruchic yo'och, raji' cu bin u c'ubiquen ti' yʌn yejerechex.
A teno' taren in yamtic mac tu cotor. Rajen yʌn in bin quinsbir, quire' tabar u nup'ur u t'ʌn C'uj. Chen otsir a mac a cu bin u mucu c'ubiquen. Jach manan tsoyir wa mʌ' ti' yʌn tera' ich yoc'ocab.
Judas a tu mucu c'ubaj Jesús. Caj cata'b ti' Jesús: ―Ten ix ti', quin bin in c'ubiquech Jaj Ts'urir? Caj u nuncaj Jesús: ―Taj, tech ca bin c'ubiquen.

Ti' toy u janʌnob caj u ch'aj yo'och pan caj u yʌn t'ʌnaj C'uj: ―Bayo' C'uj, quire' caj a ts'aj tenob in co'ochob pan. Caj u rʌc t'axaj ti' u camsʌwinicob caj ya'araj ti'ob: ―Jantex a je' pan quire' in bʌq'uer. Jantex.

Caj ts'oc u rʌc janticob yo'och pan. Jesús caj u chucaj u chan ruch yejer u c'ab u wich uva. Caj u yʌn t'ʌnaj C'uj: ―Bayo' C'uj, tech caj a ts'aj tenob u c'ab u wich uva. Caj u ts'aj ti' u camsʌwinicob. Caj ya'araj ti'ob: ―Rʌc uq'uex ca'ca' xot' techex a wu'quiquex u c'ab u wich uva.
A je' u c'ab u wich uva in q'uiq'uer quir u nup'ur u t'ʌn a ba' caj u ch'ic araj C'uj uch. A je' cu bin joc'ar in q'uiq'uer soc yiric ya'ab mac cu bin u jawsicob u si'pirob.
Quin wa'aric techex. Mʌ' in yʌnyʌn ca' uq'uic u c'ab u wich uva hasta cu xur t'ʌn. Ca' bin in wuq'uej yejerechex tu cu bin u reyinticob C'uj.
Jesús cu tsicbar ti' Pedro: Ca bin a wa'aric mʌ' a wer maquen
Caj ts'oc u c'ayob caj joc'ob, caj binob ich u witsir Olivos.

Caj c'uchob ich u jo'r u witsir Olivos. Caj ya'araj Jesús ti' u camsʌwinicob: ―Techex tu cotorechex ca bin a p'ʌtiquenex ac'bir baje'rer, quire' ca' nup'uc u t'ʌn C'uj tu cu ya'aric: “Quin cha'ic u quinsic a mac a cu cʌnantic yʌrʌc' tʌmʌn yuc. Rajen cu bin u puts'urob yʌrʌc' tʌmʌn yuc.”
Ca' bin in wʌc'ʌs riq'uir tin quimirir ―quij Jesús―, ti' ca bin a wiriquenex ich u ru'umin Galilea. Chen a teno' quin yʌn c'uchur ich u ru'umin Galilea.
Pedro caj ya'araj ti' Jesús: ―Cax tu cotor in wet camsʌwinicob cu bin u p'ʌtiquechob. Chen a teno', mʌ' in p'ʌtiquech.
Jesús caj ya'araj: ―Jach taj quin wa'aric tech Pedro. Mʌ' toy c'aynʌc cax ac'bir cax mʌna' u nup u tenin u c'ay cax ca bin a wa'aric ti' mac: “Mʌ' jin wer mac Jesús.”
Caj ya'araj Pedro: ―Cax wa in quet quimin yejerech. Mʌ' jin wa'aric, mʌ' jin werech. Bayiri' xan, caj ya'araj u yet camsʌwinicob.
Jesús cu t'ʌnic C'uj ich u chan corir Getsemaní
Caj c'uchij Jesús yejer u camsʌwinicob ich u chan corir u c'aba' Getsemaní. Caj ya'araj ti' u camsʌwinicob: ―Te' a yʌn cutarex. Tar quin bin bʌytʌc quir in t'ʌnic C'uj.
Jesús caj u pʌyaj tu pach Pedro yejer u pararob Zebedeo. Ca'tur u pararob. Jesús caj u yʌnxchun u tucur tu yor, bayiri' xan, caj u yʌnxchun u muc'yaj. Jach manan cu tucur caj c'uchij bʌytʌc.
Caj ya'araj ti'ob: ―Jach tucur in ca'. Tan u jach bin in wor irej wa bin in ca' quimin. Te' a p'atʌrex mʌ' ja wenʌnex soc a yamtiquenex.

Jesús caj bin u t'ʌnej C'uj. Jach bʌytʌc caj bin. Caj pʌch'raj caj u t'ʌnej C'uj. Caj ya'araj ti' C'uj: ―Wa tsoy ta t'ʌn tech, Tet. Mʌ' ja cha'ic in jach muc'yaj an ten bic caj a toc araj uch. Wa tsoy ta t'ʌn tech ca cha'ic in muc'yaj. Baxuc ten tsoy tin t'ʌn xan, ca' tac ti' ten a ba' a c'at ten.
Caj riq'uij Jesús caj wʌc'ʌs ur tu yʌn u camsʌwinicob. Caj yiraj wenʌn u ca'ob. Caj u t'ʌnaj Pedro: ―Mʌ' wa c'ucha'an a worex a muc'tic a wenex a tresechexe' ca' a yamtenex cax turi' hora?
Mʌ' ja wenʌnex, t'ʌnex C'uj soc mʌ' u tumtiquex a worex quisin. Cax a chen c'at aja'anechex soc a t'ʌniquechex C'uj ti' ten. Chen mʌ' ju c'uchur a worex a muc'tic a wenʌnex quire' jach tac a wenʌnex.
Caj wʌc'ʌs bin Jesús caj u wʌc'ʌs t'ʌnaj u Tet: ―Wa tsoy ta t'ʌn, Tet, in muc'yaj ich cruz cax a ba' cu tar ten, tsoy.
Caj ric' Jesús caj wʌc'ʌs urij ich u camsʌwinicob. Caj yiraj wenʌn u ca'ob. Mʌ' tu muc'tob u wenʌnob. Mʌ' u p'irir u wichob.
Caj u p'ʌtaj u camsʌwinicob Jesús caj bin u ca' t'ʌnej C'uj. Mʌna' u nup u tenin u bin u t'ʌnic C'uj. Bayiri' caj u wʌc'ʌs t'ʌnaj u Tet an ten bic ca'che'. Baxuc caj u yʌn t'ʌnaj sam.

Caj ur Jesús ich u camsʌwinicob caj ya'araj ti'ob: ―Tsoy a wenʌnex baje'rer, jes a bʌjex. Baje'rer c'uchij tu q'uinin tu chuquenob a teno' taren in yamtic mac tu cotor. Bin u c'ubiquenob ti' mac a yʌn u si'pir.
Riq'uenex ―quij―, ca' xico'on ic pajic a mac a mucu c'ubiquen quire' tan u tar.
Chuc Jesús

Ti' toy cu tsicbar Jesús caj c'uchij Judas Iscariote ra'iri' ti' u camsʌwinicob Jesús yejer a oncejo'. Yet taracob a jach pim. U rʌc ch'amʌnob u mascab, bayiri' u rʌc ch'amʌnob che', caj tarob quire' tuchi'ta'b ten u jach tsuririrob sacerdote yejer u jach ts'urirob u cajar u winiquirob judío a cu ya'aric a Nuxibo'.
Mʌ' toy c'uchuc Judas ich Jesús caj u toc araj ti'ob a pimo': ―A ca wiriquex in ts'u'ts'ic u p'uc. Ra' ca chuquiquex.
Seb caj u juts u bʌj ich Jesús caj ya'araj Judas ti' Jesús: ―Taren in wʌjcamsʌyʌjirech. Caj uts'benta'b u p'uc ten Judas.
Jesús caj u nuncaj: ―In yajech baj tarech a wirej? Caj u juts'ob u bʌj a pim caj chucob u c'ʌb Jesús ca' xicob mʌcbir.
Ti' yʌn ra' u camsʌwinic Jesús u nup. Caj u jit'aj u mascab caj u ch'ʌcaj u xiquin u c'urew u jach ts'urir sacerdote. Caj rac u xiquin.
Jesús caj ya'araj: ―Jup a mascab tu pix. Mʌ' ja wirej, a mac cu quinsic mac yejer mascab raji' cu wʌc'ʌs bin quinsa'r yejer mascab.
Mʌ' ja wirej, wa c'ucha'an in wor in t'ʌnic in Tet soc seb cu tuchi'ta'r yʌjmasirob u t'ʌn C'uj quir u taquicob ten. Jach pim yʌjmasirob u t'ʌn C'uj.
Chen mʌ' in t'ʌnic in Tet quire' ca' u yʌn nup'ur u t'ʌn, a caj u toc araj uch, soc u tar ten an bic caj u toc araj uch.

Caj ts'oc u t'ʌnan Pedro caj ya'araj Jesús ti' a mac yʌjchuquirob Jesús: ―Biquinin caj tarechex tera' yejer che', bayiri' yejer a mascabex quir a chuquiquenex iren wa yʌjac'ricyʌjiren ba'. Rajra' ti' yʌnen ich carem naj caj in camsechex tu ca wocarex a c'ujintex C'uj. Biquinin mʌ' a toc chuquenex uch?
A ba' u ber ten baje'rer, quire' caj u toc araj uch yʌjtseq'uirob u t'ʌn C'uj. Quire' nup' a ba' ts'iba'an uch. Ra'iri' u q'uinin u camsʌwinicob Jesús caj rʌc puts'ob. P'at Jesús tu junan.
Jesús caj bin purbir ʌcʌtan u jach ts'urir u winiquirob judío

Yʌjchuquirob Jesús caj bin purbir Jesús ich Caifás. Ra' u jach ts'urir sacerdote. Bayiri' ti' yʌn yʌjcamsʌyʌjirob u t'ʌn Moisés. Ti' yʌnob u jach ts'urirob u cajar u winiquirob judío a cu ya'aric a Nuxibo'. U rʌc much'quinmʌnob u bʌj xan.
Pedro pachir u bin tu cu binob Jesús. C'ʌs nanach cu tar Pedro hasta c'uchij tu re'a'an yatoch Caifás. Caj oc ich tu re'a'an yatoch Caifás. Caj curaj yejer policía soc u yiric ba' u ber ti' Jesús.
U jach ts'urirob sacerdote yejer tu cotor u ts'urirob u winiquirob judío. Ti' u much'quinmʌnob u bʌj quir u wayticob quir u tus ta'quicob u jo'r Jesús soc u quinsa'r Jesús.
Mʌ' c'ucha'an yor u waytob quir u tus ta'quicob u jo'r Jesús. Cax jach pim mac cu tar quir u tus ta'quicob u jo'r Jesús. Pachir caj tarob ca'tur u winiquirob judío.

Caj ya'arajob ti' u jach ts'urirob u winiquirob judío: ―Tij cu'yaj ya'aric a je' xiba', cu bin u rʌc jubsic carem naj tu quij c'ujintiquex C'uj. Je' u ca' ts'ʌpquintique' u jer carem naj ca' bin ts'ocac u man mʌna' u nup u q'uinin.
Caj ric' u ch'ictar Caifás caj ya'araj ti' Jesús: ―Biquinin mʌ' a c'ʌs nunquic ti' a mac tan u ta'quic a jo'r tech?

Jesús mʌ' u c'ʌs nunquic. U jach ts'urir sacerdote caj u chuchaj C'uj caj ya'araj: ―C'uj cu yiric, a cuxa'ano'. Arej to'on wa tech u pararech C'uj a mac caj u toc araj C'uj yʌn u tar quir u ta'quic tu cotor mac? Arej to'on soc taj quic najtic.

Jesús caj u nuncaj caj ya'araj: ―An ten bic caj a wa'araj raji' ten. Raji' ten ca bin a wiren ich u noj C'uj a jach manan chich u muc'. Quire' taren in yamtej tu cotor mac. Je' a wiric in tar tu muyarir ca'anan.

U jach ts'urir sacerdote seb caj u jʌtaj u noc' quire' ts'ic. Quire' cu tucra' cu pach'ic C'uj Jesús, an ten bic caj u nuncaj Jesús rajen Caifás caj ya'araj: ―Ba'wir ti' u jer mac quir u ta'quic u jo'r? A bʌjirex caj a wu'yajex cu pach'ic C'uj.
Arex ten ba' ca tucriquex ti'? Robob u ts'urirob u winiquirob judío caj ya'arajob: ―Toc yʌn u si'pir ca' u yʌn u quimin.
Caj u tubajob u wich Jesús caj u jʌts'ajob. U jerob caj u tac' jʌts'tajob Jesús.
Caj u tus ya'arajob: ―Arej tenob mac tu tac' jʌts'tajech wa C'uj caj u tuchi'tajech quir a ta'quic mac tu cotor, quire' baxuc caj a wa'araj.
Mʌ' in wer mac Jesús

Ti' toy yʌn Pedro ich tancab tu re'a'an yatoch Caifás. Caj u juts' u bʌj turiri' xquic ich Pedro. Ra' u c'urew Caifás. Caj ara'b ti' Pedro: ―A techo' ―quij ya'araj―, a wet man Jesús ich u ru'umin Galilea xan.
Pedro caj ya'araj ʌcʌtan tu cotor mac: ―A teno', mʌ' in wer ba' ca wa'aric a techo'.
Sansam caj bin Pedro ich u jor yatoch Caifás. U jer xquic caj yiraj caj ya'araj: ―A je' xiba' xano', yet man Jesús ra' cu tar ich u cajar Nazaret.
Pedro caj ya'araj, caj u chucaj C'uj, caj ya'araj: ―A C'ujo' cu yiric. Mʌ' jin wiramʌn xib a ca c'atic teno'.
Sansam caj u juts' u bʌj xib ich Pedro caj ara'b ti' Pedro: ―Taj tech a wet mʌn Jesús uch. A mʌ' quet baxuc a t'ʌn yejer Jesús.
Caj ara'b Pedro, caj u chucaj C'uj, Pedro caj ya'araje': ―C'uj cu yiric, mʌ' in wiramʌn xib a je' ca wa'aric teno'. Cax cu quinsiquen C'uj. Bayiri' caj c'aynʌj cax.

Pedro caj u c'asaj yic' a ba' ara'b ten Jesús uch: “Mʌ' toy c'aynʌc cax mʌna' u nup u tenin ca bin a wa'aric mʌ' a wer maqueni'.” Caj joc' Pedro caj oc'nʌjij. Caj jach qui' oc'nʌjij Pedro, caj u jach tucraj u bʌj.
